Open call for tenders for external service provision in time & means in the field of digital solution lifecycle management (DIGIT-TM III)

The scope of this procedure is to procure external consultancy services in time & means. It involves the provision of external services performed from within the territory of the European Union by external contractors in the field of digital solution lifecycle management. More specifically, it covers digital solution management,  its definition, design, construction, transition, operations, support, exploitation and data management.

Note on the value: Please disregard Section 2.1.3 and 5.1.5 of this Contract Notice which refers to "estimated value". This reference is set by default due to technical limitations of the system. The value referenced in these sections is the ceiling of the framework contract, respectively the ceiling of each lot. The ceiling is the maximum amount that the contracting authority will be entitled to spend for the framework contracts resulting from this procurement procedure.

Note on the Foreign Subsidies Regulation: Any economic operator participating in this public procurement procedure where the value of the lot or the aggregate value of all the lots to which the tenderer applies is equal to or greater than EUR 125 million, shall notify the contracting authority of all foreign financial contributions of at least EUR 4 million per third country received in the last three years prior to the notification pursuant to Article 28(1)&(2) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2560, or they shall submit a declaration pursuant to Article 29(1) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2560 listing all foreign financial contributions received in the three years prior to the declaration and confirming that such contributions are not notifiable. When no foreign financial contributions were received in the last three years prior to the declaration, a declaration is still necessary to confirm that no FFCs were received. Notifications or declarations shall be submitted by using the Form FS-PP available at Foreign Subsidies Regulation - European Commission (europa.eu).

Note on the place of performance: Please disregard Sections 2.1.2. and 5.1.2. (of each lot) of this Contract Notice which, due to technical limitations of the system, is entitled “Place of performance” instead of “Place of delivery” and which imprecisely mentions “Anywhere”.
The places of delivery for each lot are the following:
Lot 1: Brussels (Belgium), Geel (Belgium), Luxembourg (Luxembourg), Ispra (Italy), Seville (Spain), Petten (Netherlands), Co. Meath/Grange (Ireland), Karlsruhe (Germany);
Lot 2: Brussels and Geel (Belgium);
Lot 3: Luxembourg (Luxembourg), Ispra (Italy), Seville (Spain), Petten (Netherlands), Co. Meath/Grange (Ireland), Karlsruhe (Germany).
 
More detailed information on the places of delivery and service provision is included in the document Service Requirements and Service Level Agreement (Appendix 2 to the framework contract).
